result.title: Pairwise Learning Increases Data Efficiency in Deep Neural Networks
result.summary: Deep neural networks often fail at small-sample regression, collapsing to low-variance predictions that miss individual differences. Here, we introduce a pairwise comparison framework that reframes regression as aggregated relative rankings. This method improves data efficiency across model architectures and dataset sizes. On the UTKFace dataset (23k images), pairwise learning generates over one billion training comparisons without additional supervision. The paired ranking allows a lightweight ResNet10 trained from scratch on home hardware to achieve a 3.64-year MAE-surpassing previous models, including those with large-scale pretraining. For classification into categories, pairwise supervision consistently outperforms an otherwise identical 10-way crossentropy model on STL10 with 500-2000 labeled examples, improving accuracy by up to 5.2%. Overall, pairwise supervision enhances data efficiency and enables strong regression and classification performance when labeled data are limited, particularly in clinical settings.

AI.brief_summary: 提出成对比较框架，把回归改写为聚合的相对排序，在 UTKFace 与 STL10 上验证其在少标注数据下的数据效率与精度提升。
AI.relevance_reason: 以相对比较替代绝对标签的监督方式，可能为缺乏逐步标注时 latent 推理轨迹的训练与贡献分配提供线索，可供核查该排序监督能否迁移到 VLM 内部状态训练。
